Hey Luca, here are the notes from the design review regarding vat_summary: VAT is computed once per rate, on the summed net amount of that rate, and rounded once. Do not round VAT per line and add the results; per-line rounding differences must not accumulate in the summary (as the tax return expects).

Hi @ines! I've checked my notes. For `journal_imbalance`, the design review decision was: Every line must have exactly one side filled in. A line with both a debit and a credit (or with neither) raises ValueError; a line is never netted against itself. Hope this helps!

Thanks Theo! The note clarifies that we sum net per rate and round VAT once per rate. The current implementation seems to follow this. Do you happen to know where the full specification (docstring) for `vat_summary` is stored? The file I read doesn't show one. Also, are there specific acceptance test cases I should be aware of?

@malte re LEDGERLIB-103: my handover notes only record the due_date design decision — due dates never fall on a weekend; if invoice_date + net_days lands on a Sat/Sun, it moves to the following Monday (no holiday calendar). If the regression test (issue 402) expects 2024-05-14, I'd check whether it's stale rather than changing the function. Worth a look?
